name: Provincie Gelderland Subsidieregeling Bodemherstel in Gelderse bossen
summary: Provincial project subsidy for soil surveys and quickscans of acidified forest in the Gelders Natuurnetwerk, followed by applying buffer material such as lime, shell grit or rock flour to restore soil acidity and nutrient availability. Open to owners or long leaseholders of the site; at least 20 ha and prior consultation required.
reporting: The grantee must cooperate with monitoring of the effects for ten years after the grant decision.

eligibility.rule: Having ownership or leasehold control over the project area
Soil survey and quickscan show the buffer treatment will improve the forest
Having an acidification-sensitive project area of at least 20 hectares for buffer substances
Normally applies at most 3 tonnes/ha of lime or shell grit, or 10 tonnes/ha of rock dust
Applying buffer substances to no more than two-thirds of the project area
No provincial grant to the applicant for the same or similar activity in this area in the past five years
Applies for buffer treatment alone or for a soil survey or quickscan followed by buffer treatment

documents: Bank statement no more than a year old, for a first application or changed account
Buffer treatment-only route: action plan with soil survey and quickscan by an independent qualified firm
